newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH MAY BUILDING PERMITS VOLUME +40 PCT YR/YR.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH MAY BUILDING PERMITS VOLUME +40 PCT YR/YR.

text.p: The construction volume for which new building permits were granted rose 40 percent year-on-year in May to slightly over four million cubic metres, Statistics Finland (SF) said in a statement on Friday.
In January-May, new building permits were granted for a construction volume of 14.9 million cubic metres, up 17 percent year-on-year, SF said.
Building permits were granted for over 14,000 new apartments in January-May, up by 60 percent over 5,000 apartments compared to the year-ago period, SF said.
In Helsinki and nearby areas, the number of building permits for apartments doubled to 4,557 in January-May, SF said.
